title: Integrated electrical modeling of circulating tumor cells for enhanced dielectrophoretic trapping and electroporation
task: Integrated DEP trapping and electroporation for selective CTC manipulation and treatment
key_results: Electric field strength requirements: 1–4 kV/cm for CTCs/WBCs, 10–40 kV/cm for platelets; impedance decreased monotonically with voltage (1–25 V across 200 µm gap) at mid-frequency range (10–100 kHz), confirming enhanced membrane permeability
comments: Multiphysics modeling captures pore dynamics and heterogeneous membrane charging, but validation limited to THP-1 cells rather than primary CTCs, reducing direct clinical translatability claims.

model_io.model: Microfluidic impedance sensing platform with microfabricated electrodes

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cell-type-specific electric field thresholds exist that enable selective CTC treatment while minimizing off-target effects on WBCs and platelets
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: CTCs/WBCs require 1–4 kV/cm while platelets require 10–40 kV/cm due to smaller diameter and higher charging threshold

hypotheses.hypothesis: Impedance spectroscopy can detect membrane permeabilization and conductivity changes under electroporation conditions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Mid-frequency impedance (10–100 kHz) decreased with voltage; reactance suppressed and resistance stabilized, indicating transition from capacitive to conductive transport

title: Probiotic Bifidobacterium animalis subsp. lactis DS109-B11 ameliorates age-related muscle weakness via AMPK activation
task: Identify gut microbes that enhance muscle function via AMPK activation to treat sarcopenia
key_results: DS109-B11 increased AMPK phosphorylation in C2C12 myotubes; oral DS109-B11 improved grip strength by ~20% in aged mice and increased myofiber cross-sectional area by ~15%; partially preserved muscle mass in botulinum toxin atrophy model
comments: The mechanistic link between microbial metabolites and AMPK activation remains incompletely characterized; identification of the active metabolite(s) in MCS would strengthen the contribution.

hypotheses.hypothesis: DS109-B11-derived metabolites activate AMPK to enhance myogenic differentiation
hypotheses.result: MCS increased AMPK phosphorylation and improved myogenic differentiation in C2C12 cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: AMPK activation via DS109-B11 protects muscle from catabolic stress (dexamethasone, denervation)
hypotheses.result: DS109-B11 mitigated dexamethasone-induced atrophy in vitro and partially preserved muscle mass in botulinum toxin atrophy model

hypotheses.hypothesis: Oral DS109-B11 improves age-related muscle weakness through systemic AMPK activation
hypotheses.result: Aged mice receiving DS109-B11 showed improved grip strength, motor performance, increased myofiber cross-sectional area, and elevated muscle AMPK phosphorylation

title: Classification of fallers in Parkinson’s disease through machine learning based feature analysis
task: Classification of fallers in Parkinson's disease using machine learning
key_results: Extra Trees classifier achieves 88% internal and 89% external validation accuracy; fear of falling, balance/gait measures, and autonomic dysfunction are principal discriminative domains
comments: External validation on a separate cohort strengthens claims, though the 98-sample external set is relatively modest for robust generalization assessment.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multidomain clinical and gait features enable accurate faller classification
hypotheses.result: Extra Trees achieves 88-89% accuracy with identified domains (FoF, balance/gait, autonomic dysfunction)

title: Advancing target discovery through disease-specific integration of multi-modal target identification models and comprehensive benchmarking system
task: Disease-specific drug target identification and benchmarking
key_results: TargetPro achieves strong predictive performance across 38 diseases; TargetBench 1.0 systematically evaluates target identification models including LLMs
comments: While the unified framework is comprehensive, clinical validation of novel targets identified by TargetPro remains unclear from the abstract.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Disease-specific target models outperform generic approaches
hypotheses.result: TargetPro reveals disease-specific patterns supporting tailored detection models

title: TMPA-HC: a two-stage heterogeneous multi-population algorithm with cooperative search for high-dimensional feature selection
task: High-dimensional feature selection with reduced redundancy
key_results: TMPA-HC achieves competitive feature selection with consistent convergence across multiple benchmark datasets; two-stage framework reduces redundancy in selected subsets
comments: The method combines established techniques (Fisher-score filtering, multi-population search) but computational cost comparison with baseline methods lacks specifics.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Heterogeneous multi-population cooperation reduces computational cost in high dimensions
hypotheses.result: TMPA-HC demonstrates improved efficiency and convergence stability
Selected feature subsets show reduced redundancy compared to single-stage methods

title: Interactive AI assisted pediatric burn assessment based on smartphone images
task: Burn depth assessment and segmentation from smartphone images
key_results: SAM-DR achieves 0.96 Dice score for wound segmentation; interactive thresholding enables burn depth discrimination comparable to expert clinicians
comments: Using only 294 images from 94 patients limits generalization; the transfer learning approach is pragmatic but external validation across diverse burn types is needed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pre-trained SAM with dense regression head enables accurate burn depth prediction from smartphone images
hypotheses.result: SAM-DR achieves 0.96 Dice score and depth discrimination comparable to clinical experts

title: Effects of hydrodynamic nonlocality on electromagnetic wave propagation and topological properties of magnetoplasmas
task: Analyze topological properties and edge modes in nonlocal magnetized plasmas
key_results: Derived explicit dispersion equations for bulk and edge modes; computed Chern numbers for nonlocal dispersion bands; demonstrated impact of nonlocality on edge mode count and topological protection in Voigt configuration
comments: Solid theoretical contribution bridging hydrodynamic nonlocality and topological physics, though lacks numerical or experimental validation of the predicted effects.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Nonlocality modifies the number and topological protection of edge modes compared to local models
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—nonlocality significantly alters edge mode structure and protection in magnetized plasma systems

title: Multi-objective optimization for 3D heterogeneous WSN deployment using an enhanced Genghis Khan shark algorithm
task: Multi-objective 3D heterogeneous WSN deployment under K-coverage and C-connectivity constraints
key_results: EnMOGKSO achieves best Friedman ranks in hypervolume (2.04) and IGD (2.38) on CEC 2020; heterogeneous WSN results: coverage ~11–12, connectivity ~7 vs. baselines ~5–7 and ~4–5
comments: Solid metaheuristic with feasibility-aware handling of constrained mixed discrete optimization; leader-pursuit dynamics are well-motivated but similar principles appear in existing shark algorithms.

model_io.model: EnMOGKSO (Enhanced Multi-Objective Genghis Khan Shark Optimizer)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dual archive-guided selection with feasibility-first environmental selection improves convergence-diversity balance under tight constraints
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—best HV and IGD ranks; higher coverage/connectivity with stable cost vs. weaker baselines

title: Enhanced cybersecurity threat detection using novel tri-metaheuristic loss functions in generative adversarial networks with adaptive attention preservation for network traffic augmentation
task: Cybersecurity threat detection via GANs with tri-component loss function and adaptive attention for traffic augmentation
key_results: Achieves 98.73% accuracy and 0.987 F1-score across 7 cybersecurity datasets; 40% reduction in training energy via adaptive attention; ablation: 49.4% improvement from augmentation, 50.6% from loss combination
comments: Thorough empirical validation with honest reporting of limitations (poor infiltration attack recall 16.44–28.13%, ground truth coverage 1.8%), but contribution is primarily engineering integration rather than algorithmic novelty; generalization beyond tested datasets remains uncertain.

model_io.model: GAN with tri-component loss (9 differentiable components)
inputs: 7 cybersecurity datasets (NSL-KDD, UNSW-NB15, CIC-IDS2017, CIC-IDS2018, Bot-IoT, CICDDOS2019, CSE-CIC-IDS2018)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Systematic integration of nine loss components with energy-aware adaptive attention improves threat detection accuracy and reduces training cost
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—98.73% accuracy, 40% energy reduction; ablation shows 50.6% gain from loss integration

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cross-dataset transfer learning without retraining achieves competitive performance
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed—87.45–94.23% accuracy on transfer, but limited by dataset-specific attack types

title: Long-range structural and magnetic coherence in embedded mesospin metamaterials
task: Fabricate magnetically coherent metamaterials with long-range order via ion implantation
key_results: Iron-ion embedded palladium thin films exhibit spontaneous antiferromagnetic long-range order without annealing
Sharp magnetic Bragg peaks with mesospin form factor modulation observed via resonant X-ray scattering
comments: Embedding strategy elegantly circumvents lithographic disorder, though scalability to macroscopic devices and stability under operational conditions warrant further investigation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Embedded mesospins spontaneously order antiferromagnetically without external field or annealing
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; as-fabricated state shows extended antiferromagnetic coherence

hypotheses.hypothesis: Structural coherence correlates with magnetic long-range order in embedded architecture
hypotheses.result: Supported by sharp Bragg peaks coupled to form factor evidence
